name: staleness_expires_synthesis
description: Opposite-polarity parents at rounds 1 (tars T 1.0) and 5 (ix F 1.0) on the same claim_key, current_round=5, staleness_k=3 -> cutoff=2. The round-1 parent is dropped BEFORE synthesis, so the pair no longer coexists and NO contradiction is synthesized: the surviving state is just the F. Pins the min(parents) round stamp / evidence-recompute semantics (2026-07-20, GuitarAlchemist/hari#27): a synthesized C is supported only while BOTH parents are inside the staleness window, so a carried C stamped min(1,5)=1 would expire at exactly this cutoff — carried state and fresh recompute agree. Under the old max-stamp a carried C (round 5) would have outlived its round-1 parent as a ghost contradiction.
